smallHealthPotion.desc: A basic healing potion that restores a small amount of health.

bigHealthPotion.desc: A powerful healing potion that restores a big amount of health.

strPotion.desc: A combat-enhancing potion that temporarily increases ATK, allowing attacks to deal more damage for a short time.

shieldBattery.desc: Absorbs up to 40 incoming damage over the next 3 turns.

leechSerum.desc: For 3 turns, heal for 25% of the damage you deal.

mirrorShard.desc: For 1 turn, reflects 50% of incoming attack damage back to the enemy.
